apocalyptic-steeds.name: Apocalyptic Steeds
apocalyptic-steeds.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit only. This unit has +1" M.

argath-the-king-of-blades.name: A'rgath, the King of Blades
argath-the-king-of-blades.description: KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. While the bearer is within your army's Shadow of Chaos, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons instead.
argath-the-king-of-blades.short: +1 A & S to melee (+2 in Shadow of Chaos)

avatar-of-perfection.name: Avatar of Perfection
avatar-of-perfection.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH MONSTER model only. At the start of each phase, if no other friendly units are within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll its Advance and Charge rolls and ignore any modifiers to its Move characteristic, Advance rolls and Charge rolls.
avatar-of-perfection.short: Alone: re-roll Advance & Charge, ignore move modifiers
avatar-of-perfection.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh Monster model only

bane-forged-weapons.name: Bane-forged Weapons
bane-forged-weapons.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit only. This unit's attacks have +1 S.

brazenmaw.name: Brazenmaw
brazenmaw.description: Legiones Daemonica Khorne model only. Add 2 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

cankerblight.name: Cankerblight
cankerblight.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within 6" of the bearer fails a Battle-shock test, the bearer can use this Enhancement: one model in that unit, chosen by its controlling player, is destroyed. When it is used, your army's Daemonic Terror rule inflicts no mortal wounds.
cankerblight.short: Enemy failing Battle-shock within 6" loses a model

dreaming-crown.name: Dreaming Crown
dreaming-crown.description: [AURA] LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH model only. While a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit (excluding MONSTERS) is within 6" of the bearer, add 1 to Hit rolls for melee attacks made by models in that unit.
dreaming-crown.short: Aura: nearby Slaanesh get +1 to melee Hit rolls

droning-shroud.name: Droning Shroud
droning-shroud.description: [AURA] LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE MONSTER model only. While a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE unit is within 6" of the bearer, it can only be targeted by ranged attacks made from within 18".
droning-shroud.short: Aura: nearby Nurgle can only be shot from within 18"
droning-shroud.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Nurgle Monster model only

fade-to-darkness.name: Fade to Darkness
fade-to-darkness.description: SHADOW LEGION model only. At the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer's unit destroyed one or more enemy units this phase and is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
fade-to-darkness.short: After a kill in the Fight phase, return to Reserves

false-majesty.name: False Majesty
false-majesty.description: [AURA] LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH model only. While a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit (excluding MONSTERS) is within 6" of the bearer, add 1 to Wound rolls for melee attacks made by models in that unit.
false-majesty.short: Aura: nearby Slaanesh get +1 to melee Wound rolls

font-of-spores.name: Font of Spores
font-of-spores.description: [AURA] LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE MONSTER model only. While a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE unit is within 6" of the bearer, improve the Armour Penetration of that unit's weapons by 1.
font-of-spores.short: Aura: nearby Nurgle weapons improve AP by 1
font-of-spores.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Nurgle Monster model only

furys-cage.name: Fury's Cage
furys-cage.description: Legiones Daemonica Khorne Monster model only. Each time the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer suffers D3+1 mortal wounds, and until the end of the phase, each time it makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
furys-cage.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Khorne Monster model only
furys-cage.short: Re-roll hits & wounds (bearer takes D3+1 MW)

gateway-unto-damnation.name: Gateway Unto Damnation
gateway-unto-damnation.description: Legiones Daemonica Khorne Monster model only. The bearer's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 2+ instead of on a 6. In addition, if the bearer has destroyed one or more enemy units this battle, the bearer has the Deadly Demise D3+3 ability, instead of any other Deadly Demise ability on its datasheet.
gateway-unto-damnation.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Khorne Monster model only
gateway-unto-damnation.short: Deadly Demise 2+; D3+3 after a kill

improbable-shield.name: Improbable Shield
improbable-shield.description: [AURA] LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH model only. While a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit is within 6" of the bearer, its models have Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.
improbable-shield.short: Aura: nearby Tzeentch FNP 4+ vs psychic & mortal wounds

inescapable-eye.name: Inescapable Eye
inescapable-eye.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH model only. In your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield and your opponent has one or more Flux tokens, you gain one additional Flux token.
inescapable-eye.short: Command phase: gain an extra Flux token

infernal-puppeteer.name: Infernal Puppeteer
infernal-puppeteer.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH MONSTER model only. In your Shooting phase, when the bearer's unit is selected to shoot, each enemy unit visible to a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit has +9" detection range until the bearer's unit has finished shooting.
infernal-puppeteer.short: When shooting: visible enemies +9" detection range
infernal-puppeteer.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Tzeentch Monster model only

leaping-shadows.name: Leaping Shadows
leaping-shadows.description: SHADOW LEGION model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

maggot-maws.name: Maggot Maws
maggot-maws.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE model only. In your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 6" of the bearer: it must take a Battle-shock test, then roll one D6 — on a 3+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds. When this is used, your army's Daemonic Terror rule inflicts no mortal wounds.
maggot-maws.short: Shooting phase: Battle-shock test, then 3+ → D3 MW

malice-made-manifest.name: Malice Made Manifest
malice-made-manifest.description: SHADOW LEGION model only. At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit and roll one D6: on a 2-5 it suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6 it suffers 3 mortal wounds.
malice-made-manifest.short: Start of Fight: D6 — 2-5 → D3 MW, 6 → 3 MW

mantle-of-gloom.name: Mantle of Gloom
mantle-of-gloom.description: [AURA] SHADOW LEGION model only. While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit, its models have -1 Objective Control.
mantle-of-gloom.short: Enemies engaged with the bearer's unit have -1 OC

neverblade.name: Neverblade
neverblade.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH MONSTER model only. The bearer's melee weapons have +2 Strength, +1 Attacks and improve their Armour Penetration by 1, and the bearer's melee attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.
neverblade.short: Melee: +2 S, +1 A, +1 AP, +1 to hit
neverblade.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Tzeentch Monster model only

slaughterthirst.name: Slaughterthirst
slaughterthirst.description: [AURA] Legiones Daemonica Khorne model only. While a friendly Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit (excluding Monsters) is within 6" of the bearer, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LANCE] ability.

soul-glutton.name: Soul Glutton
soul-glutton.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH MONSTER model only. At the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer's attacks destroyed one or more enemy models this phase, it can regain up to D3 lost wounds.
soul-glutton.short: Heal up to D3 after killing in the Fight phase
soul-glutton.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh Monster model only

soul-hungry-slaughterers.name: Soul-hungry Slaughterers
soul-hungry-slaughterers.short: Heroic Intervention/Fire Overwatch targeting this unit is -1 CP
soul-hungry-slaughterers.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention/Fire Overwatch stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

soul-shattering-charge.name: Soul-shattering Charge
soul-shattering-charge.short: After a charge, nearby models can fight engaged foes
soul-shattering-charge.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit only. When this unit is selected to fight, if this unit made a charge move this turn, you can use this ability. If you do, when determining which models in this unit can fight, friendly models that are within 3" of enemy units engaged with this unit can target those enemy units.

soulstealer.name: Soulstealer
soulstealer.description: SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONICA model only. Each time the bearer destroys an enemy model with a melee attack, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer is within your army's Shadow of Chaos: on a 4+, the bearer regains 1 lost wound.
soulstealer.short: Melee kills can heal: D6, 4+ regains 1 wound

swollen-with-power.name: Swollen with Power
swollen-with-power.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Character model only (excluding Monster units)
swollen-with-power.description: LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER model only (excluding MONSTER units). This model has +2 W.

the-endless-gift.name: The Endless Gift
the-endless-gift.description: NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONICA model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

the-everstave.name: The Everstave
the-everstave.description: TZEENTCH LEGIONES DAEMONICA model only. The bearer's ranged weapons have +1 Strength and +3" Range. While the bearer is within your army's Shadow of Chaos, they have +2 Strength and +6" Range instead.
the-everstave.short: Ranged: +1 S & +3" range (+2 / +6" in Shadow of Chaos)
